subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the primary full-product reference for <Subject 1>, defining its complete three-quarter product view and overall proportions.
<Picture 2> is the product-detail reference for <Subject 1>, defining its hinge, temple inlay, bridge, nose-pad hardware, side profile, and surface finish; its collage layout is not reproduced.
<Picture 3> is the three-view identity reference for <Subject 2>; it defines one consistent model and is not reproduced as a multi-person lineup or white-background character sheet.
<Subject 1> is the black-and-gold sunglasses defined by <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. <Picture 1> provides the complete product geometry: glossy black thick-rimmed rectangular frame with softly rounded lower corners, dark olive lenses, a slim polished gold bridge, gold nose pads, and black temples with a gold T-shaped side accent. <Picture 2> provides macro references for the hinge, gold temple inlay, bridge, nose-pad hardware, side profile, glossy finish, and exact black-and-gold material response.
<Subject 2> is the young East Asian woman defined by the front, side, and rear views in <Picture 3>, with the same facial proportions, long naturally wavy dark hair, slim build, and youthful appearance. The three-view sheet is used only to preserve her identity and body proportions; its white reference background and duplicated figures do not appear in the target video.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second 9:16 TikTok-style commerce video presents <Subject 1> through a fast product hook, a clean try-on transformation with <Subject 2>, a confident lifestyle modeling shot, and a final macro product payoff. The edit preserves the sunglasses' exact geometry and black-and-gold details while using the model reference only for a single consistent woman.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the same young East Asian woman, facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and slim build are maintained as one continuous model rather than a three-view sheet.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a polished TikTok commerce aesthetic in a 9:16 vertical frame: bright directional studio light, crisp contrast, glossy product reflections, fast but readable cuts, subtle handheld energy, and premium black, warm gold, and clean off-white colors.

[Shot 1] An extreme macro shot opens on <Subject 1> against a warm off-white studio background. The polished gold T-shaped temple accent catches a moving strip light, creating an immediate visual hook. The camera performs a brisk 15-degree arc around the hinge while the sunglasses rotate slowly on a hidden turntable. The dark olive lens, glossy black acetate, gold bridge, and nose pads come into view without changing shape. A confident young female Mandarin voice-over (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 这副黑金太阳镜，上脸真的太提气场了。</d> On the beat, the frame makes a quick controlled turn toward the lens and its dark lens briefly fills the screen as a natural wipe.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the lens wipe reveals <Subject 2> in a bright minimalist dressing area, shown as a single living model in a chest-up three-quarter view. She wears a fitted white top and holds <Subject 1> correctly by both temples. She raises the sunglasses with a small deliberate motion, places both temple arms over her ears, and settles the gold nose pads onto the bridge of her nose. Her eyes lead toward the camera, then her chin lifts slightly as her expression shifts from neutral to quietly confident. The camera makes a short smooth push-in. The voice-over continues, <d>[Chinese] 黑色粗框修饰脸型，金色细节刚好够亮。</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, a sharp beat cut moves to a vertical medium shot in a sunlit modern city walkway. <Subject 2> walks two relaxed steps toward the camera wearing <Subject 1>. The camera tracks backward at her pace while sunlight produces stable reflections across the dark olive lenses. She turns her head slightly left, brushes one loose strand of hair behind her ear, then looks back into the lens with a restrained confident half-smile. Her hair and white top respond naturally to a light breeze. The sunglasses remain firmly aligned and retain the exact black frame, gold bridge, nose pads, hinges, and T-shaped side accents. The voice-over says, <d>[Chinese] 通勤、出街、拍照，一戴就有利落高级感。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:11.500, the shot cuts to a rapid sequence within one continuous tabletop macro move: <Subject 2>'s hand removes <Subject 1> and places it gently onto a glossy black pedestal. The camera glides from the gold bridge to the nose pads, passes the hinge and gold T-shaped temple inlay, then pulls back to a centered three-quarter hero view matching the complete product proportions of <Picture 1>. A narrow gold rim light outlines the frame while a clean white spotlight blooms behind it. The voice-over ends with, <d>[Chinese] 喜欢黑金风格，这一副值得加入你的穿搭清单。</d> Hold the final hero composition for the last half second with the full sunglasses clearly readable and no generated captions or logos.

overall_soundscape:
Clean studio room tone under Shot 1, a soft turntable mechanism, a crisp lens-wipe whoosh at 00:03.000, delicate temple-arm and nose-pad handling sounds during the try-on, light city ambience and restrained footsteps in Shot 3, then a soft placement tap and three precise metallic detail ticks synchronized with the bridge, hinge, and temple macro reveals. The Mandarin voice-over remains close, clear, energetic, and commercially polished without shouting.

non_diegetic_music:
A fashionable 112-BPM TikTok commerce beat with punchy electronic drums, a tight warm bass line, clipped synth plucks, and small metallic accents. Begin with an immediate hook hit, add a clean beat drop at the try-on reveal, maintain a confident groove through the walking shot, then use three synchronized gold-toned chimes for the final detail sweep and finish on a short decisive bass-and-synth logo-style sting.
